# Version matrix

The version data drupilot reads: one `config/targets/<major>.json` per Drupal major and `config/php/versions.json` (their shape is in `schemas/`; the `data` gate checks them, and `scripts/dev/refresh-data.sh` regenerates the values it can read from git.drupalcode.org and packagist). Only a value marked verified, and never *announced* (a statement about a release that does not exist yet), may drive a hard gate. A value left blank is unknown: drupilot detects it at runtime and never assumes it.

- **Default ranges:** target-only `^11`, keep-previous `^10 || ^11`, widest `^10 || ^11`

### Advisory notes

Never a hard gate.

- `text_with_summary`: `TextWithSummaryItem`, `TextSummaryOrTrimmedFormatter`, `TextareaWithSummaryWidget` move from `Drupal\text\Plugin` to `Drupal\text_with_summary\Plugin` in 11.5 (announced, re-verify at 11.5.0). 11.5.0 is unreleased: the with-summary field type, its widget and its formatter move from the text module to a new core module text_with_summary (the 11.5.x branch). The other text plugins stay in the text module. Source: https://www.drupal.org/api-d7/node.json?nid=3223395 (Deprecated and obsolete extensions: Text with Summary)

- **As of:** 2026-10-04
- **Released:** planned 2026-12-07/week (https://www.drupal.org/about/core/policies/core-release-cycles/schedule (02-F1, read 2026-10-03))
- **End of life:** unknown (https://www.drupal.org/about/core/policies/core-release-cycles/schedule (02-F1: unknown))
- **Updates from:** 11.3 (https://www.drupal.org/api-d7/node.json?nid=3627048 (drupal 12.0.0-beta1 release notes): updates added prior to Drupal 11.3.0 have been removed and the update system will refuse to update from Drupal 11.2 or earlier)

- **DDEV project type:** `drupal12`; Composer stability while a pre-release: `beta`
- **Toolchain cell:** `12`
- **PHP defaults:** `DRUPILOT_PHP_TARGET` 8.5, PHP_TARGET tab 8.5
- **Default ranges:** target-only `^12`, keep-previous `^11.3 || ^12`, widest `^11.3 || ^12`

## PHP rules

As of 2026-10-04; rule classes read in rector-src 2.5.2. compat: a deprecation fix whose output runs on the PHP floor; deny: never applied, also inside a level set; report-only: reported, never rewritten; removed-no-rule: a removed construct no rule fixes.

| Id | Kind | Rector rule | Deprecated in | Removed in | Output needs PHP | Drupal-safe | Verified |

| `p82-interpolation` | compat | `VariableInStringInterpolationFixerRector` | 8.2 |  |  | true | yes |
| `p82-utf8-encode` | compat | `Utf8DecodeEncodeToMbConvertEncodingRector` | 8.2 |  |  |  | yes |
| `p83-get-class-no-args` | compat | `RemoveGetClassGetParentClassNoArgsRector` | 8.3 |  |  | true | yes |

| `p85-set-accessible` | compat | `RemoveReflectionSetAccessibleCallsRector` | 8.5 |  | 8.1 | true | yes |
| `p85-null-offset` | compat | `ArrayKeyExistsNullToEmptyStringRector` | 8.5 |  |  | true | yes |
| `p85-debuginfo-null` | compat | `NullDebugInfoReturnRector` | 8.5 |  |  | true | yes |
| `p85-chr-range` | compat | `ChrArgModuloRector` | 8.5 |  |  | true | yes |

Sources:

- `p84-implicit-nullable`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration84.deprecated.php
- `p82-interpolation`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration82.deprecated.php
- `p82-utf8-encode`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration82.deprecated.php The rewrite calls mb_convert_encoding(): Drupal-safe only where mbstring is guaranteed; unaudited (AR-11).
- `p83-get-class-no-args`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration83.deprecated.php
- `p84-csv-escape`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration84.deprecated.php
- `p85-backtick`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p85-case-semicolon`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p85-set-accessible`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p85-null-offset`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p85-debuginfo-null`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p85-chr-range`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p85-ord-single-byte`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php
- `p80-optional-before-required`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration80.deprecated.php May change a public signature; unaudited (AR-11).
- `p74-implode-order`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration74.deprecated.php ; https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration80.incompatible.php
- `deny-array-first-class-callable`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/functions.first_class_callable_syntax.php Turns Form/Render API callbacks such as '#submit' =&gt; [[$this, 'submitX']] into $this-&gt;submitX(...): a closure is not serializable, so a cached form (#ajax, form state cache) fatals. templates/rector.php.tmpl skips it (S4); check-port-safety.sh flags such a closure.
- `deny-override-on-methods`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/class.override.php Adds #[\Override] by looking at the test-bed core only: a method that exists in the parent only on newer cores then fatals on PHP 8.3+ with every older core the module declares. templates/rector.php.tmpl skips it (S4); check-port-safety.sh flags #[\Override] while the range spans Drupal 10.
- `deny-readonly-property`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.oop5.properties.php#language.oop5.properties.readonly-properties A readonly property cannot be re-initialized by DependencySerializationTrait::__wakeup() (forms, plugins, controllers that get serialized). templates/rector.php.tmpl skips it (S4).
- `deny-readonly-class`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.oop5.basic.php#language.oop5.basic.class.readonly Makes every property readonly, with the same DependencySerializationTrait::__wakeup() breakage as ReadOnlyPropertyRector. templates/rector.php.tmpl skips it (S4).
- `p81-null-to-internal`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration81.deprecated.php templates/rector.php.tmpl skips it (S4): it adds (string) casts that change semantics and fail stricter project PHPStan levels. The deprecation is reported, never fixed by this rule.
- `deny-sleep-to-serialize`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php DependencySerializationTrait implements __sleep()/__wakeup(): the rewrite breaks the service re-injection drupilot code relies on (03-F-D7). PHP 8.5 only soft-deprecates them (no E_DEPRECATED).
- `deny-wakeup-to-unserialize`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php See deny-sleep-to-serialize.
- `deny-override-on-properties`: https://github.com/rectorphp/rector-src/blob/2.5.2/config/set/php85.php (in the php85 level set) Adds #[\Override] to properties, valid only on PHP 8.5; it collides with the override-attribute port-safety check while the core range spans an older PHP.
- `p85-cast-names`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php Rector fixes it only through a configured RenameCastRector (php85 set), so it is not in the compat pass.
- `p85-noop-close`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php Rector fixes it only through a configured RemoveFuncCallRector (php85 set). Only curl_close() was read on php.net; the other functions of 02-F9 are unverified.
- `p85-pdo-mysql-constants`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php output_min_php 8.4 (the Pdo\Mysql driver subclass) is not verified.
- `p85-http-response-header`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.deprecated.php The PHP version that added http_get_last_response_headers() is not verified.
- `p81-strftime`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration81.deprecated.php
- `p81-filter-sanitize-string`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration81.deprecated.php
- `p84-e-strict`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration84.deprecated.php
- `p84-lcg-value`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration84.deprecated.php
- `removed-mysql-ext`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration70.removed-exts-sapis.php
- `removed-ereg-ext`: https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration70.removed-exts-sapis.php

## Upgrade paths

As of 2026-10-04. Each source era is recognised by its signals; the graph says what each hop runs (always in the target workspace). A source and target of the same major need no hop.

### Source eras

| Era | Track | Signal | Kind | Looks for | Removed in | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | d7-assisted | `info-core-7x` | info | `.info: core = 7.x` |  | yes |
| 7 | d7-assisted | `d7-test-case` | test-api | `ere:extends[[:space:]]+Drupal(Web\|Unit)TestCase` |  | yes |
| 8 | standard | `info-core-8x` | info | `.info.yml: core: 8.x without core_version_requirement` |  | yes |
| 8 | standard | `simpletest-webtestbase` | test-api | `ere:(Drupal\\simpletest\\WebTestBase\|extends[[:space:]]+WebTestBase)` | 9.0 | yes |
| 8 | standard | `simpletest-javascripttestbase` | test-api | `ere:(Drupal\\FunctionalJavascriptTests\\JavascriptTestBase\|extends[[:space:]]+JavascriptTestBase)` | 9.0 | yes |
| 9 | standard | `removed-symbols-9` | symbols | `catalog:config/deprecations.json#lifecycle` |  | yes |
| 10 | standard | `removed-symbols-10` | symbols | `catalog:config/deprecations.json#lifecycle` |  | yes |
| 11 | standard | `removed-symbols-11` | symbols | `catalog:config/deprecations.json#lifecycle` |  | yes |

### Hops

| Hop | Kind | Rule sets | Detectors | Test conversions | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 to 11 | rewrite (experimental) |  |  |  | stages: d7-inventory, d7-successor-gate, d7-scaffold, d7-fill |
| 8 to 9 | rector | Drupal8SetList | simpletest, info-core-8x | simpletest-to-browsertestbase | reference scan decided by spike AR-39 |
| 9 to 10 | rector | Drupal9SetList | twig2-to-3, symfony4-breaks, ckeditor4, jquery-ui, prophecy | phpunit-8-9-to-10 |  |
| 10 to 11 | rector | Drupal10SetList | removed-ext-11, signature-changes | phpunit-10-11 |  |
| 11 to 12 | rector | Drupal11SetList, always Drupal12SetList::DRUPAL_120 | removed-ext-12, library-removed, migrate-drupal-usage, symfony8-constraint-validator | phpunit-annotations-to-attributes |  |

Forbidden: 7 to 12 directly (D7 lands on 11 then hops (04-F-20, H9)); the route is 7-11, then 11-12.

Sources:

- `info-core-7x`: drupilot 1.0 architecture AR-05 (source detection signals), signal 1 A Drupal 7 extension has a .info file (no .info.yml).
- `d7-test-case`: drupilot 1.0 architecture AR-05 (source detection signals), signal 6
- `info-core-8x`: drupilot 1.0 architecture AR-05 (source detection signals), signal 2 S &lt;= 8: the minor is not used.
- `simpletest-webtestbase`: drupilot 1.0 architecture AR-05 (source detection signals), signal 5 ; WebTestBase deprecated in 8.8.0, removed in 9.0.0 (04-F-64) Tests under src/Tests/ that extend SimpleTest.
- `simpletest-javascripttestbase`: https://git.drupalcode.org/project/drupal/-/raw/8.9.x/core/tests/Drupal/FunctionalJavascriptTests/JavascriptTestBase.php (@deprecated in drupal:8.6.0 and is removed from drupal:9.0.0; the file is absent on 9.0.x), read 2026-10-05 FunctionalJavascript tests of the Drupal 8 era (WebDriverTestBase replaced it).
